changeSet.author: aqua-rush
changeSet.comment: Align order_operations.operation_type CHECK with OrderOperationType enum (G23/F-ORD-008/F-ORD-024)
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE order_operations DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_operation_type_valid;

ALTER TABLE order_operations ADD CONSTRAINT chk_operation_type_valid CHECK (operation_type IN ('ORDER_CREATED', 'ORDER_PAID', 'ORDER_CANCELLED', 'ORDER_URGING', 'DELIVERY_ASSIGNED', 'DELIVERY_STARTED', 'DELIVERY_COMPLETED', 'ORDER_COMPLETED', 'REFUND_INITIATED', 'REFUND_COMPLETED', 'PAYMENT_TIMEOUT', 'DELIVERY_PHOTO_APPROVED', 'DELIVERY_PHOTO_REJECTED', 'ADDRESS_UPDATED'));
